final_text:
- Chen, Martinez, Patel (2024) show that small models under 3B parameters can improve via self-critique alone by no measurable amount.
- The authors cite Zhang et al. (2023) as foundational work on self-confirmation bias in LLMs.
- Their verifier provides binary feedback (pass/fail) on output quality, leading to an average of 18% accuracy gain on GSM8K dataset.
